text_block_list.text:
—I brought the exhausted Silence Suzuka to
the infirmary and had her rest.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer...
I'll take a short rest, if you don't mind...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Where is this?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I don't know, but... it's a lovely place.
(Whooooosh)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What a pleasant breeze...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And look at how the grasslands ripple...
It's just like the open ocean...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...!
Now I really feel like running—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Is the sky... close...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Wait, is it flying?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, she's running on top of the sky...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Incredible.
Alright, heading toward that sun...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The start...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Where did the sun go?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I wonder if that just now... was a dream?
choice_data_list: What kind of dream was it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... A vast meadow was spreading out
right before my eyes, and...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Before you know it while running,
you'll just fly away into the big sky...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...
It's nothing, hehe...
Looking at Silence Suzuka, it seemed she had gotten her energy back.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Galloping through... the night sky...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, amazing...!
It feels like I could reach the stars...!
(Wheeeew...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What is that sound...? It feels like I've heard it somewhere before...
(THUD――rustle, rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
F-Fireworksâ!?
You've gotta be kidding me...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's beautiful...
Wait, it's dangerous...!
(Wheeeew...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah, watch out, we're gonna crash—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ――Gh!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh, wait... where is this...?
choice_data_list: Did you have a bad dream?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes. It started out as such a nice dream,
but halfway through...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ugh... It still feels like fireworks are going off in my head...

She must have had a terrible nightmare...
It seemed Silence Suzuka wasn't able
to get enough rest.
